Email marketing requires an audience. We help grow your list through website signup forms optimized for conversions, lead magnets offering valuable content in exchange for email addresses, exit-intent popups capturing abandoning visitors, social media promotions encouraging signups, and in-store collection for businesses with physical locations.
Quality matters more than quantity. A list of 500 engaged subscribers who open emails and make purchases beats 10,000 uninterested people who ignore everything you send.

Welcome series are automated email sequences sent to new subscribers over their first days or weeks. These emails introduce your business, set expectations for future communication, deliver any promised lead magnet, showcase your best content or products, and encourage initial engagement. Welcome emails typically see open rates two to three times higher than regular campaigns because subscribers are most engaged immediately after joining.

Regular campaigns keep your business top-of-mind. These might be weekly newsletters, monthly updates, product launches, or educational content series. We develop campaigns including compelling subject lines that get emails opened, engaging content that provides value, clear calls to action, and mobile-optimized design since most emails are read on phones. Most Saudi businesses do well with weekly to bi-weekly emails for engaged lists.

Promotional emails drive sales through special offers, discounts, new product launches, or seasonal campaigns. Effective promotional emails create urgency through limited-time offers, clearly communicate offer value, make purchasing easy with prominent links, and include social proof like testimonials. Promotional emails work best when mixed with valuable content because sending only promotional emails trains subscribers to ignore you.

Email automation sends the right message at the right time based on subscriber behavior. Common automated sequences include welcome series for new subscribers, abandoned cart recovery for ecommerce, post-purchase follow-up and review requests, re-engagement campaigns for inactive subscribers, birthday emails, and lead nurturing for B2B sales cycles. Automation ensures no opportunity falls through the cracks.

Sending identical emails to everyone ignores that different subscribers have different interests and needs. Segmentation criteria include purchase history, engagement levels, demographic information, interests, website behavior, and location. Segmented, personalized campaigns typically see open rates 15 to 30 percent higher and conversion rates double compared to generic broadcasts.
